title: CXCL14+ fibroblasts promote development of IBD-associated fibrosis and cancer by interacting with SPP1+ macrophages via collagen IV secretion.
snippet: The pathogenesis of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) involves chronic inflammation of the gastrointestinal tract, which predisposes patients to an increased risk of fibrosis and cancer due to prolonged inflammatory stimulation.
